rules.title: Multi-year price agreement with escalation clause
rules.description: Prices apply for several years and follow agreed indices.

rules.title: Open cost structure for agreed parts
rules.description: The supplier discloses the cost components of the agreed parts.

rules.title: Joint cost workshops
rules.description: Both sides regularly look for savings together.

rules.title: Annual productivity offer
rules.description: Every year the supplier makes a concrete productivity offer.

rules.title: Longer demand outlook
rules.description: The supplier receives a demand forecast over a longer period.

rules.title: Binding capacity commitment
rules.description: The supplier commits to the required capacity.

rules.title: Early information on programme changes
rules.description: The supplier learns early about changes to programmes and volumes.

rules.title: Early warning of supply risks
rules.description: The supplier reports foreseeable supply risks immediately.

rules.title: Access to senior management
rules.description: The supplier has a direct line to the customer's senior management.

rules.title: Dedicated contact at senior management level
rules.description: The supplier names a fixed person from its senior management.

rules.title: Faster approval processes
rules.description: Approvals for the supplier follow a shortened path.

rules.title: Taking part in mutual feedback
rules.description: The supplier regularly takes part in mutual feedback.

rules.title: Early involvement in new developments
rules.description: The supplier is involved in new development projects from the start.

rules.title: Offer innovations first
rules.description: The supplier offers new solutions to this customer first.

rules.title: Insight into the technology roadmap
rules.description: The supplier sees the customer's technology planning.

rules.title: Investment in joint development goals
rules.description: The supplier invests in the jointly agreed development goals.

formats.name: Executive strategy dialogue
formats.purpose: Senior management of both sides aligns direction and goals of the partnership.

formats.name: Quarterly review
formats.purpose: Assess performance, actions and risks of the quarter together.

formats.name: Joint business planning
formats.purpose: Work out the joint plan for the coming year.

formats.name: Mutual feedback
formats.purpose: Both sides say openly what works well and what needs to improve.

formats.name: Innovation day
formats.purpose: The supplier presents new technologies and ideas.

formats.name: Value chain workshop
formats.purpose: Improve processes across both companies together.

formats.name: Relationship restart
formats.purpose: Clarify a difficult collaboration and set it up again.
